tomato_soup_can.source: YCB object set, 005_tomato_soup_can (66 mm dia x 101 mm, 349 g)

celsius_grape_can.source: Celsius Sparkling Grape Rush, 12 oz Ball Sleek can (202/204 x 602 spec sheet: 57.37 mm body dia, 155.63 mm open height; lid seam adds ~1.5 mm -> 157 mm). Mass = 355 ml x 1.0 g/ml + ~13 g aluminium = 0.368 kg (estimate). Friction: painted aluminium on wood, no measured value found; 0.5, randomized in training

printed_frame.source: Unbranded 3D-printed PLA sleeve; no online match. Size is a visual estimate, mass = PLA 1.24 g/cm3 x estimated wall volume, friction = hard plastic on dry wood

lego_tree.source: Custom LEGO build (TreeHacks), no online model. Size measured from photo 4 using the 1x4 tile (31.8 mm, LEGO standard) as a ruler: ~69 x 18 x 75 mm. Density 477 kg/m3 = 2x4 brick 2.3 g / 31.8x15.8x9.6 mm (hollow ABS). Friction: no measured ABS value found online; 0.4 (hard plastic), randomized in training

so101_motor_holder.source: SO-ARM100 repo, STL/SO101/Individual/Motor_holder_SO101_Base.stl: 55.1 x 38.1 x 28.0 mm ring, 13.3 cm3 -> ~16 g PLA (1.24 g/cm3) if solid; friction = hard plastic on dry wood

masking_tape.source: Masking tape roll lying flat (partly used). Outer diameter 111 mm measured from the video with the AprilTag (22.3 mm) as a ruler, consistent in 3 frames; standard 3 in (76 mm) cardboard core. Width 18 mm (3/4 in, the common masking tape width; the roll is clearly lower than the 22 mm tag). Mass ~80 g: tape annulus 111/82 mm x 18 mm ~79 cm3 at ~0.9 g/cm3 + ~7 g core; weigh it to be exact. Friction: paper backing on cloth ~0.6
masking_tape.material: paper masking tape on a cardboard core

celsius_can.source: Celsius Sparkling Grape Rush, 12 fl oz slim aluminium can (opened, treated as empty). Size: 12 oz slim can ~6.13 in tall x 2.25 in wide (brainbound.blog slim can guide; Ball 202 slim can 6.13 in flanged height) = 57 x 57 x 156 mm. Mass: empty 12 oz aluminium can ~13 g (typical; 0.368 kg if full, 355 ml). Friction: painted aluminium on cloth ~0.5
